content:
Hello!
I want to use Lean for compiler and optimization experiments. I'll need to quickly test ideas.

Can you please tell me if it's possible to quickly prototype and test ideas in Lean? Won't I have to rewrite half the project each time?

I read an article about game development in Rust. It didn't work for the person involved. He had to constantly refactor the code.

@Filipp please stop asking vague question where you just say "I would like to do X, what can I do?", where X is some very general problem. People are happy to help, but please show what you did before asking.
